title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1224: Fall of invincible, reveal of traitor (2)

title.p: Chapter 1224: Fall of invincible, reveal of traitor (2)

section.p: Lade coldly said, “In the battle where Ye Batian had died, his friend lost a future body. However, both First Divine and Nan Wujiang still have their tri-life bodies. At the very least, we can see that their tri-life bodies are not recultivated bodies. In that case, there must be one more expert hiding somewhere. Sure enough, it’s you. Wan Tiansheng, you’re too talented. None of us would have imagined that you were that expert back then.”
Wan Tiansheng said, “Yes, it was me. But since you know it was me, why are you still here? Are you not afraid of death?”

“Yes, we are.” Lade said, “We’re very scared of death. But…your tri-life body is dead. Wan Tiansheng, just how much of your previous strength do you still have? Do you really think we’re here unprepared? Nope. You’re wrong. We have prepared a lot to kill you. But I do admit that the sheer number of hidden experts humanity has is quite surprising.”
He laughed, “Wan Tiansheng, would you believe me if I say that all six of us are only here for you?”
Those words shocked all onlookers. What?
Devil King Lade said, “We have never been sure if that mysterious expert was you. But we are all here for that mysterious expert. Looks like it really was you. You’re a patient man, Wan Tiansheng.”
The three Invincibles who had appeared earlier spoke as well.
“Wan Tiansheng, so it was you. What a surprise.”
“We suspected you before, but we were unsure. When First Divine exposed his identity, we even thought it was him. But…he still has his tri-life body. Wan Tiansheng, you’re too careless.”

Wan Tiansheng laughed helplessly, “Not at all. I didn’t tell Lan Tian to do anything. He insisted because, well, he’s crazy. He believed he was shifting attention from me, but instead, he ruined my plan. That idiot has always believed himself right.”

Not far away, the hundreds of Lan Tians who were in the middle of beating up a Pseudo Invincible giggled and said, “How can you talk about me like that, you heartbreaker? I did all this for you, Wan Tiansheng. How could you lie to me? You promised me that you’re only a Sunmoon…”
Wan Tiansheng said, “And I’m indeed a Sunmoon. Is that wrong?”
He looked at the two Invincibles before him and said, “You insisted on forcing me out. Did you believe that you could defeat me with your crippled bodies?”
With a smile, he took a step forth. With that, a character appeared and created a massive suppression around him.
“Set!”
Instantly, the space around him was frozen.
“But you’re not wrong. I have never taken my eldest senior brother or teacher into consideration. I only planned to kill the traitor myself. Alas, you insist on throwing your lives away.”
With each step he took, a new character appeared.
“Battle!”
“Die!”
“Fury.”
“Culture.”
He was only a ninth-stage Sunmoon, yet he was terrifyingly strong. In the blink of an eye, he was only a step away from the two Invincibles. All around him, space was being ripped apart.

All by himself, he was able to suppress two Invincibles in combat. There was no doubt that he was the strongest person present. Every character of his was no weaker than Ye Batian’s character. Liu Wenyan was completely dumbstruck.
Was this…really Wan Tiansheng? Just how powerful was the multiple character faction?
Holy shit!
All these people were so strong. Why did they hide away and watch as the rest of them suffered?
Liu Wenyan yelled, “Principal Wan, you have hidden yourself too deeply.”
Wan Tiansheng was too busy to reply. His characters fused together, pushing his strength to an even higher level as he threw a punch and punctured reality itself.

With a wave of his other hand, Great Xia City itself seemed to have appeared above Nanyuan. Then, Wan Tiansheng wrapped his fingers around the Heart Cultivating Pavilion before pulling it out of the ground.

Everyone watched on with utter shock as the Heart Cultivating Pavilion was revealed to be a…sword. As Great Xia City overlapped with Nanyuan City, it almost felt like they were fighting within academy grounds.
Wan Tiansheng blanked out slightly when he found this scene…familiar.
Su Yu was blanking out as well.

This seemed to be quite a familiar scene. He had not put much thought to what he saw previously. During his previous visit to the Heart Cultivating Pavilion, he had witnessed the sight of Hong Tan and the others fighting bitterly. He had also witnessed the sight of him unleashing carnage in the academy.
However, he had outgrown the academy. There was no longer any need for him to unleash slaughter in the academy. But this overlap of reality…had brought the academy here. Su Yu was stunned.

Wan Tiansheng was slightly stunned as well. Was the scene he saw…going to happen now? A helpless smile formed on his face as understanding dawned on him. He had been wondering about the battle in the academy.
So this was the moment when it would happen.
The Heart Cultivating Pavilion was a sword.
First, the sword was drawn.
Then, the sword was swung.
The two Invincibles did not stay idle. Space rippled as two Rivers of Time appeared and swirled around Wan Tiansheng. He met the rivers with his sword, sending shockwaves everywhere as they clashed.
With a roar, Devil King Lade threw countless punches as explosions erupted all around him. Time was sundered, and space was shattered.
After blanking out momentarily, Su Yu laughed.
His mask fell off his face.
A face everyone knew appeared before all of them.
With a laugh of amusement, he said, “Would you believe me if I say I saw this scene before?”
Nobody answered.
Su Yu!

He continued, “When you are too outstanding, it is indeed hard to hide. Since all the top experts are having so much fun, the rest of you need to have some fun as well, right? Allow me to entertain you.” He took a step forth, drew his saber, and moved toward Dao Cheng.
With a sigh, Dao Cheng said, “It’s you indeed. You’re too good at hiding.”

Next, a powerful aura erupted from Dao Cheng’s body as he was shrouded by a silhouette. His blood boiled and his aura changed completely. From the third-stage Mountainsea Realm, he instantly reached the Sunmoon Realm. He did not stop there as his aura continued climbing.
The same was happening to several geniuses around him, each with a silhouette wrapped around their body. Every one of them seemed to have instantly become a Sunmoon.

Seeing that scene, Su Yu laughed, “This is more like it. You’re all geniuses. It is only natural for you to have your own trump cards. Sure enough, you have the top experts of your races attached to your body.”
Meanwhile, the rest of the young geniuses were all stunned.
Holy shit!

So this was how a battle between young geniuses was supposed to unfold? In fthe ace of such might, what were they? Every single one of the top geniuses was emitting the aura of a Sunmoon even when they were only Mountainseas. Were these supposed to be Mountainseas?
Nonsense!
More like Sunmoons!
And they wouldn’t even be ordinary Sunmoons.

Su Yu laughed, “I’ve been holding myself back against you guys for quite a while. Before the principal arrived, I didn’t dare to attack. I was worried that you would be too fragile to last long against me. Hey, traitor, you must be watching. Look at your granddaddy, Su Yu. Look at how strong I am after cultivating for only one year.”
His yang acupoint opened.
His death qi surged.
He fully revealed his strength, not bothering to hold anything back anymore.
Not far away, Wan Tiansheng was cursing, “Screw this! A Cloudbreach fighting Mountainseas? And these are the so-called Mountainseas he’s supposed to fight?”
Holy shit.

He had started doubting the vision he saw, but the so-called battle between a Cloudbreach and Mountainseas was really happening. Could Su Yu even be considered a Cloudbreach anymore? Could these young geniuses even be considered Mountainseas anymore?
“Stop messing around! I don’t need that traitor to appear right now!” Wan Tiansheng grumbled, “Can’t you see that I’m facing two Invincibles?”
Su Yu blanked out slightly. What was the meaning of that? Was this too much for Old Wan to handle?

He smiled and said, “Principal, we can at least expose his identity. Even if we all die after that, he won’t be able to keep hiding anymore. Let’s see if that dog has the courage to keep hiding after seeing all this.”
Wan Tiansheng laughed despite himself. While swinging his sword, he muttered, “Are the War Shrine and Knowledge Seeking Realm still unwilling to help?”
Even now, there were still over twenty Sunmoons watching on the sidelines. Meanwhile, the human Sunmoons on the battlefield were all fighting a superior number of enemies.
Sunmoons were still dying one after another.
Zhang Qi said, “The multiple character faction seems to have a lot of trump cards. In that case, I believe you can handle this yourself.”
Wan Tiansheng sighed, “Do you really think we have more trump cards?”
“I don’t know.” Zhang Qi pulled further away before continuing, “Principal Wan, we won’t be able to do much even if we join the battle.”
Wan Tiansheng had nothing else to say.
On the ground, a massive battle had erupted.

Su Yu smashed his hammer into Dao Cheng, forcing Dao Cheng to take several backs even as death qi rippled out and spread in all directions. Without saying a single word, Su Yu continued pushing his yang acupoint. His aura grew stronger and stronger.

After consuming a drop of sixth-stage Sunmoon blood essence, he felt stronger than a sixth-stage Sunmoon. But he consumed another drop without any hesitation. The second burst of power was too much for his body to handle, causing his skin to tear and his blood to flow.
He merely grunted and bore the power silently. That was a drop of eighth-stage Sunmoon blood essence. His combat strength was brought to an entirely new height.
“Die!”

Struck by a hammer, Dao Cheng started coughing blood. At this point, Su Yu had turned almost fully into a death spirit. Dao Cheng fought back relentlessly, and before long, Zhan Wushuang, Ming Yue, and Xuan Wuji joined the battle.

Mo Duona was the only person who had yet to join the battle. He looked at Su Yu and sighed, “You are much stronger than I’ve expected. Ability blood essence? Are you relying on the ability blood essence?”
He didn’t know.
He only knew that Su Yu was fighting with the strength of an eighth-stage Sunmoon.
Every one of these top geniuses was fighting with combat strength surpassing their level.

As they fought, stray attacks flew everywhere. Several myriad race Sunmoons were instantly blasted apart when they were hit by Su Yu’s stray hammer strikes. Several human Sunmoons were also instantly torn apart by the stray attacks of the other young geniuses.
